stated: The Conservative Party will maintain record flooding funding of £5.6 billion over 2021-2027 to continue protecting homes, farms, and businesses, alongside the Flood Recovery Framework and Farming Recovery Fund.

source.quote: We will maintain this record flooding funding to continue to protect homes, farms and businesses. This will work alongside the Flood Recovery Framework and Farming Recovery Fund to directly support communities, businesses and farmers affected by flooding.

bearing_set.reason: Flood defence funding directly affects water quality, climate resilience, and environmental protection from flooding, earning a real verdict on the clean environment fundamental.
Protecting homes and infrastructure from flood events bears directly on community safety and national resilience, earning a real verdict on safety and security.

The Farming Recovery Fund specifically protects agricultural output, with a concrete mechanism to food costs (O2's food-costs indicator); broader flood protection also shields household finances from catastrophic repair/displacement costs, bearing on real disposable income.

Flood defences protect farms (agricultural productivity), businesses (continuity), and homes (economic assets); Environment Agency modelling of avoided damages makes the aggregate living-standards and productivity effect non-negligible and mechanistically concrete.

membership_note: The policy's two genuine bearings are environmental resilience (O6) and economic protection of productive assets (O13). Effects on cost of living (O2) via farm protection and on public finances (O12) via continued committed spend are real but marginal or already baked into the baseline — neither clears the non-negligible bar for a distinct verdict.
